verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents noise-reduction controls. It learns review preferences from chat feedback (docs-7, docs-51), excludes lock, binary and generated files via path filters (docs-69), defaults to incremental rather than full re-reviews (docs-15), and presents findings to help decide what to fix first (docs-79). Hands-on reports are mixed: one team removed it as too verbose with many false positives (comm-3), while others call its reviews clean and actionable (comm-14) and say it improves with feedback (comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit severity labels on comments, documented comment deduplication, and evidence or metrics showing a low false-positive rate.
